text: God is sovereign over all creation and works all things according to His will.
God created the heavens and the earth out of nothing.
God is holy and calls His people to be holy.
God is love, and love comes from Him.
God is merciful and gracious, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love.
God is faithful; He keeps His covenant.
God never lies and His word proves true.
God is omniscient, knowing all things.
God is omnipotent; nothing is too hard for Him.
God is just and will judge the world in righteousness.
Jesus is the only way to the Father and salvation.
Jesus is the way, the truth, and the life.
Jesus is our High Priest who sympathizes with our weaknesses.
Jesus is fully God and fully man.
Jesus died for our sins and rose again for our justification.
Jesus is the resurrection and the life.
Jesus gives abundant life.
Jesus is the Good Shepherd who lays down His life for the sheep.
Jesus is the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world.
Jesus intercedes for us at the right hand of God.
The Holy Spirit convicts the world concerning sin, righteousness, and judgment.
The Holy Spirit regenerates and renews us.
The Holy Spirit indwells and seals believers.
The Holy Spirit helps us in our weakness and intercedes for us.
The Holy Spirit produces fruit in believers: love, joy, peace, etc.
The Holy Spirit leads us into all truth.
The Holy Spirit empowers believers for witness and service.
Believers are baptized by one Spirit into one body.
The Holy Spirit gives spiritual gifts for the common good.
Do not grieve the Holy Spirit.
All have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.
The wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life.
Humans are created in the image of God.
The heart is deceitful above all things.
Apart from Christ, we are dead in trespasses and sins.
No one is righteous on their own.
Pride goes before destruction.
Man does not live by bread alone but by every word from God.
We are fearfully and wonderfully made.
The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.
Salvation is by grace through faith, not works.
Salvation is found in no one else but Jesus.
Whoever believes in Jesus shall not perish but have eternal life.
Repent and believe the gospel for forgiveness.
If we confess with our mouth and believe in our heart, we will be saved.
God saved us according to His mercy, not our works.
There is now no condemnation for those in Christ Jesus.
We are justified by faith and have peace with God.
Christ suffered once for sins, the righteous for the unrighteous.
Salvation includes regeneration by the Holy Spirit.
Love the Lord with all your heart, soul, and mind.
Love your neighbor as yourself.
Take up your cross and follow Jesus.
Be transformed by the renewal of your mind.
Pray without ceasing.
Rejoice always, give thanks in all circumstances.
Walk by the Spirit and not gratify the desires of the flesh.
Do not be anxious; make requests known to God.
Cast all your anxieties on Him because He cares for you.
Let your light shine before others.
God will never leave nor forsake you.
All things work together for good for those who love God.
God has plans for welfare and a future and hope.
If we confess our sins, He is faithful to forgive.
God is able to keep you from stumbling.
The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
God gives strength to the weary.
Perfect peace for those whose mind is stayed on Him.
God supplies every need according to His riches.
Nothing can separate us from the love of God in Christ.
The word of the Lord remains forever.
Faith comes from hearing the word of Christ.
The joy of the Lord is your strength.
In everything give thanks, for this is God's will.
God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble.
Seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness.
Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
The truth will set you free.
Do justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with God.
Endurance produces character, and character produces hope.
We are more than conquerors through Him who loved us.
Present your bodies as a living sacrifice.
The Lord disciplines those He loves.
Lay up treasures in heaven.
The peace of God guards hearts and minds.
We have been crucified with Christ; Christ lives in us.
God works in us to will and to work for His good pleasure.
Our citizenship is in heaven.
The Lord is near to the brokenhearted.
He who began a good work will complete it.
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness.
Forgive others as God forgave you.
The greatest is love.
Wisdom from above is pure, peaceable, and gentle.
The eyes of the Lord are on the righteous.
Delight yourself in the Lord; He will give you desires of your heart.
Train up a child in the way he should go.
The steadfast love of the Lord never ceases.
We will see Him as He is and be like Him.
To live is Christ, and to die is gain.
God is compassionate and will not forget the cry of the afflicted.
The Lord is slow to anger and great in power.
God’s kindness leads us to repentance.
The Lord searches the heart and tests the mind.
God gives good gifts to those who ask Him.
The Lord is a refuge for the oppressed.
God’s steadfast love endures forever.
The Lord executes justice for the fatherless and widow.
God is light, and in Him is no darkness at all.
The Lord knows the days of the blameless.
Jesus is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
Jesus is the author and perfecter of our faith.
Jesus has overcome the world.
Jesus is the bread of life; whoever comes to Him shall not hunger.
Jesus bore our sins in His body on the tree.
Jesus is the light of the world; whoever follows Him will not walk in darkness.
Jesus is the true vine; we are the branches.
Jesus has all authority in heaven and on earth.
Jesus is able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through Him.
Jesus came that we might have life and have it abundantly.
The Holy Spirit bears witness with our spirit that we are children of God.
The Spirit of God gives life and peace.
Walk by the Spirit to avoid gratifying the desires of the flesh.
The Holy Spirit teaches us all things and reminds us of Jesus’ words.
Do not quench the Spirit.
The Spirit helps us pray when we do not know how.
Believers are temples of the Holy Spirit.
The Spirit of adoption cries “Abba! Father!”
Keep in step with the Spirit.
The Holy Spirit distributes gifts as He wills.
Guard your heart with all vigilance, for from it flow the springs of life.
The Lord weighs the heart.
Every intention of man’s heart is evil from his youth.
We are God’s workmanship, created for good works.
The tongue has the power of life and death.
Do not be conformed to this world.
Man looks at the outward appearance, but God looks at the heart.
The natural person does not accept the things of the Spirit.
Put to death what is earthly in you.
Renew your mind daily to discern God’s will.
We are saved by grace through faith as a gift from God.
God made us alive together with Christ.
The blood of Jesus cleanses us from all sin.
Whoever calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.
God chose us in Christ before the foundation of the world.
We have been adopted as sons through Jesus Christ.
Our old self was crucified with Him.
We are a new creation in Christ.
The free gift of righteousness leads to eternal life.
God predestined us for adoption to the praise of His glory.
Abide in Christ and He will abide in you.
Deny yourself, take up your cross daily.
Be doers of the word, not hearers only.
Let your speech always be gracious.
Serve one another through love.
Be quick to hear, slow to speak, slow to anger.
Honor your father and mother.
Husbands, love your wives as Christ loved the church.
Children, obey your parents in the Lord.
Whatever you do, do it heartily as for the Lord.
The prayer of a righteous person has great power.
Ask in faith without doubting.
If you abide in me and my words abide in you, ask whatever you wish.
Trust in the Lord with all your heart.
The just shall live by faith.
Faith is the assurance of things hoped for.
Without faith it is impossible to please God.
Pray for those who persecute you.
Enter God’s presence with thanksgiving.
Continue steadfastly in prayer.
Count it all joy when you meet trials.
The testing of your faith produces steadfastness.
God will not let you be tempted beyond your ability.
We rejoice in our sufferings.
The Lord is near to the brokenhearted.
Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
In this world you will have tribulation, but take heart.
The Lord delivers the righteous out of all afflictions.
My grace is sufficient for you; My power is made perfect in weakness.
We are afflicted in every way, but not crushed.
God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.
The Lord will fight for you; you need only to be still.
I will never leave you nor forsake you.
He who is faithful in little is faithful in much.
Store up for yourselves treasures in heaven.
The meek shall inherit the earth.
Blessed are the peacemakers.
The crown of life is for those who love Him.
We shall reign with Him if we endure.
Our light and momentary affliction produces eternal glory.
The fear of the Lord prolongs life.
A soft answer turns away wrath.
Let everything that has breath praise the Lord.
The Sabbath was made for man.
Give, and it will be given to you.
The greatest among you shall be your servant.
Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you.
You are the salt of the earth.
The harvest is plentiful, but the laborers are few.
Behold, I am with you always, to the end of the age.
God is a consuming fire.
The Lord is righteous in all His ways.
God’s mercy is greater than the height of the heavens.
The Lord will accomplish what concerns me.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
The Lord gives wisdom generously to those who ask.
God’s thoughts toward us are more than the sand on the seashore.
The Lord is good to all, and His mercy is over all that He has made.
God will be exalted among the nations.
The Lord restores the soul.
Jesus is the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end.
Jesus is the bright morning star.
In Jesus are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
Jesus is the head of the church, His body.
Jesus was tempted in every way yet without sin.
Jesus is the mediator of a new covenant.
Jesus gives living water that becomes a spring of eternal life.
Jesus is King of kings and Lord of lords.
No one comes to the Father except through Jesus.
Jesus loved us and washed us from our sins by His blood.
The Holy Spirit is the guarantee of our inheritance.
The Spirit searches the depths of God.
Be filled with the Spirit.
The Holy Spirit sanctifies us.
The Spirit of truth guides us into all truth.
Grieve not the Holy Spirit of God.
The fruit of the Spirit includes patience, kindness, and self-control.
The Holy Spirit empowers us to put sin to death.
The Spirit gives utterance and boldness.
Live according to the Spirit.
The soul who sins shall die.
Sin crouches at the door; its desire is contrary to you.
We have all become like one who is unclean.
God made Him who knew no sin to be sin for us.
Repentance leads to life.
The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
We are not our own; we were bought with a price.
Put off your old self, which is corrupted by deceitful desires.
Be renewed in the spirit of your minds.
Put on the new self, created after the likeness of God.
Eternal life is knowing the only true God and Jesus Christ.
God desires all people to be saved and come to the knowledge of the truth.
We are justified by His grace as a gift.
The Lord is not slow to fulfill His promise but patient toward you.
Whoever believes has eternal life and has crossed from death to life.
We have boldness and access with confidence through faith in Him.
He who believes in the Son has the testimony in himself.
Salvation belongs to our God who sits on the throne.
The gospel is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes.
We are heirs of God and fellow heirs with Christ.
Obey God rather than men.
Present yourself to God as one approved.
Let love be genuine. Abhor what is evil; hold fast to what is good.
Outdo one another in showing honor.
Be constant in prayer.
Bless those who persecute you; bless and do not curse.
Rejoice with those who rejoice; weep with those who weep.
Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
Whatever is true, honorable, just, pure—think on these things.
The Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials.
A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
Death and life are in the power of the tongue.
Let no corrupting talk come out of your mouths.
Be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another.
Walk in a manner worthy of the calling to which you have been called.
Speak the truth in love.
Do all things without grumbling or disputing.
The fear of the Lord is hatred of evil.
A gentle tongue is a tree of life.
Iron sharpens iron, and one man sharpens another.
We look not to the things that are seen but to the unseen.
Our citizenship is in heaven, and from it we await a Savior.
The sufferings of this present time are not worth comparing with the glory.
Hope does not put us to shame.
Wait for the Lord; be strong, and let your heart take courage.
The Lord will fulfill His purpose for me.
Blessed is the man who remains steadfast under trial.
Cast your burden on the Lord, and He will sustain you.
The joy of the Lord is your strength.
God is faithful, and He will not let you be tempted beyond your ability.
The kingdom of God is not a matter of eating and drinking but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
Seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness.
Go therefore and make disciples of all nations.
The fields are white for harvest.
Freely you have received; freely give.
The night is far gone; the day is at hand.
We shall be like Him when He appears.
There is a crown of righteousness for those who have loved His appearing.
The former things have passed away.
Behold, I am making all things new.
Humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you.
Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you.
Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
The prayer of faith will save the one who is sick.
A cheerful heart is good medicine.
Commit your work to the Lord, and your plans will be established.
The steps of a man are established by the Lord.
Those who wait for the Lord shall renew their strength.
I can do all things through Him who strengthens me.
To live is Christ, and to die is gain.
